title: Single editor session lock per account

expectation.example: 同一个管理员账号在浏览器甲已进入编辑页，浏览器乙再登录；乙点击接管后进入编辑，甲停止编辑。甲崩溃后等待租约过期，新的地点可以重新进入。
expectation.expected: 第二个地点默认提示账号已在别处使用；接管后旧地点的心跳、保存、发布和历史恢复都被拒绝，新地点可以继续编辑和保存。
expectation.unchanged: 公开班表查看不受限制；工作区版本 CAS 冲突保护仍保留；旧工作区数据和本机恢复副本不丢失；会话锁只限制编辑和写入。
expectation.fallback: 接管或心跳失败时关闭编辑器并保留本机恢复副本；网络中断不自动覆盖云端，恢复网络后可重新获取或接管。

answers.originalFailure: Before this change, the server had no account-scoped editor lease; the new PGlite regression test now covers the concurrent-session entry and rejects the second session.
answers.laterChanges: A takeover can invalidate the old editor between heartbeats, so save, publish and history restore also carry the lease id; CAS remains the final version guard.
answers.finalArtifact: 202611170002_single_editor_session.sql plus the locked CloudBackend calls and 231-file full test result prove the local implementation. Live Supabase execution and two-browser acceptance still require the owner.

review.missedScope: The first design could have protected only save; the propagation matrix and locked publish/restore tests cover every write entry and heartbeat failure.
review.rootCause: The original system had version CAS but no server-side account session ownership, so concurrent editors were detected only after a save.
review.earlyDetection: For future cross-device editing changes, update the propagation matrix before coding and test acquire, takeover, expiry, every write RPC, recovery retention and CAS together.

automaticVerification.verify: Passed: typecheck, full tests, performance tests and production build.
